project: GenX Leadership Academy Bounded Dual-Stream RAG

requirements.name: Mock Transcript Dataset Parsing
requirements.target_node: Read Transcripts File & Parse Transcripts Array
requirements.evidence: readWriteFile reads /data/mock_transcripts.json; Parse Transcripts Array parses UTF-8 JSON without BOM, validates array structure, maps each session to { json: transcript }.

requirements.name: Turn Sampling (First 40 + Last 20 for >60 turns)
requirements.evidence: Evaluates transcript.length. If > 60: first40.concat(last20); else slice(). Verified no duplicate sampling for <= 60 turns.

requirements.name: Classification Output Schema
requirements.evidence: Prompts llama3.2:1b for summary, meeting_type, confidence_score. Validate Classification parses JSON, clamps confidence 0.0-1.0, falls back safely if regex needed.

requirements.name: Confidence Threshold (Client Coaching >= 0.80)
requirements.evidence: If node evaluates is_accepted === true, requiring meeting_type === 'Client Coaching' AND confidence_score >= 0.80.

requirements.name: Relational Archive for Rejected Meetings (Zero Embeddings)
requirements.target_node: Format Rejected Record & Transactional Archive Rejected
requirements.evidence: Firewall Gate false branch routes to archive_rejected_meeting($1..$6) and loops back to Process Sessions Sequentially. Never invokes Ollama embedder or knowledge_vault.

requirements.name: Conceptual Coaching Framework Stream
requirements.target_node: Ollama Framework Extractor & Format Dual-Stream Chunks
requirements.evidence: Extracts framework name, definition, mechanism, application, and source timestamps. Preserves meaning without inventing frameworks.

requirements.name: Coach-Only Verbatim Voice Stream
requirements.evidence: Strictly filters turns on speaker === 'Dr. Sara Hegy'. Client speech is 100% excluded. Non-adjacent turns preserved individually. SES-101: 280, 402, 154 chars; SES-102: 261, 393, 132 chars.

requirements.name: 1024-Dimensional Embeddings
requirements.target_node: Ollama Chunk Embedder & Validate & Assemble Chunks
requirements.evidence: Ollama bge-m3 embeds all 4 chunks. Validate & Assemble Chunks checks Array.isArray and length === 1024 and Number.isFinite for all dimensions. PL/pgSQL function validates vector_dims = 1024.

requirements.name: Atomic Per-Session Ingestion
requirements.evidence: Calls ingest_session_vault(p_session_id, p_chunks::jsonb) with advisory locking. Deletes prior records for session_id and inserts all 4 chunks atomically.

requirements.name: Session Isolation & Sequential Processing
requirements.evidence: Process Sessions Sequentially runs batchSize 1. Each accepted session completes embedding and database replacement before next session begins. Zero session mixing.
